_doc: Pixel coordinates of UI locations where civ-specific art renders, at 1920x1080 (gamescope native). Confidence levels: HIGH=measured from a fresh screenshot, MEDIUM=inferred from row-spacing on a measured anchor, LOW=guessed from common AoE3 layouts. Use validate_art_visual.py to consume. The 'kind' tells which inventory key the cropped pixels should be perceptually compared against (e.g. p1_civ_flag → civmods_flag_wpf or html_flag).
_calibrated: 2026-05-08 (Single Player Skirmish lobby, 8-player FFA layout, base-game civ list — ANW mod active but no civ pre-selected)

skirmish_lobby._layout_doc: 8 player rows. P1 = self (host), shows user's Steam avatar + name + chosen civ flag + color. P2..P8 = AI slots, each shows civ portrait button + flag + color. Row 1 begins at y≈150 and rows are spaced 106px apart (extrapolation matches existing lobby_coords.json y=170, 276, 382, ...).

p1_user_avatar.described: Steam profile avatar (NOT mod art) — left of P1 name

p1_civ_flag.described: P1 chosen-civ flag — middle of row

p1_color_swatch.described: P1 color swatch (yellow box with rank number)

p2_civ_portrait_btn.described: P2 small civ-portrait button (?-icon when no civ set, leader portrait when set). Click target = civ picker.

skirmish_lobby._extrapolation_doc: P3..P8 = same x; y = 274 + (slot-2) * 106. So P3=380, P4=486, P5=592, P6=698, P7=804, P8=910. Confidence MEDIUM because we only directly observed P1+P2; row-spacing comes from measured opponent_civ_pickers in lobby_coords.json.

civ_picker._layout_doc: Modal opens centered in left half of screen, ~700px tall. Lists 10 civs at a time, sorted alphabetically. Each row: small 64x64 flag icon + civ name. Picker has OK / Deck Builder / Cancel buttons at the bottom.

row_flag_icon.described: Small flag icon at left of each civ row in the picker. Click ROW (not just flag) to select. Cropped pHash of this 44x44 icon = HTML flag thumbnail.

in_match_hud._doc: These values are LOW-confidence — not directly measured this session. Captured from common AoE3 DE 1920x1080 layout knowledge. Validate by re-measuring once a match is running. The HUD 'leader portrait' typically lives top-right above the ESC menu button.

home_city._doc: Home City scene, F8 menu. Coords LOW — not screenshotted this session.

civ_flag_banner.described: Large civ flag banner in HC view

skirmish_button.described: navigation only; no civ art rendered here
